details.name: Printing A Sequence of Repeated Numbers (Case 1)
details.description: Construct a program that receives an integer N from the user and prints a sequence of space-separated numbers from 1 to N such that each number in the sequence is repeated 5 times.

details.name: Printing A Sequence of Repeated Numbers (Case 2)
details.description: Construct a program that receives an integer N from the user and prints a sequence of space-separated numbers from 1 to N such that the N-th number in the sequence is repeated N times.
